title.en: Araw Ng Paglalathala At Pagtatanyag Ng Kasarinlan Ng Pilipinas
title.orig: An Act Declaring August 1 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday to Be Known as the “Araw Ng Paglalathala At Pagtatanyag Ng Kasarinlan Ng Pilipinas”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12073_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Short Title. - This Act shall be known as "The Bacoor Assembly of 1898 Act".

Declaration of Policy. - The State recognizes the vital role of history in fostering unity, national identity, nationalism, and nation-building. It shall ensure that historical dates and events are preserved, promoted, popularized, and made accessible to the public as part of the country's heritage.

Special Working Holiday. - August 1 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday to be known as the "Araw ng Paglalathala at Pagtatanyag ng Kasarinlan ng Pilipinas", in commemoration of the promulgation of the declaration of Philippine Independent during the Bacoor Assembly in Bacoor, Cavite, on August1, 1898, which was subsequently ratified by the Malolos Congress as Acta Agosto Uno.

Role of Cultural Agencies and the Department of Education. - Cultural agencies led by the National Commission for Culture and the Arts are hereby mandated to promote the historical significance of August 1 and the events surrounding the Bacoor Assembly of 1898. The Department of Education shall develop and implement lesson plans that highlight the importance of this day, ensuring that students are educated about its relevance and importance.

Separability Clause. - If any part or provision of this Act is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions which are not affected shall continue to be in full force and effect.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
